note: Toddler-friendly events near North Portland, Vancouver and the coast, soonest first. Many holiday dates come from guides or listings rather than the organizers, so check before going.

events.title: Chrysanthemum Festival
events.detail: A floral design showcase with illuminated evenings at Lan Su Chinese Garden. $18.00.

events.title: Mini Movers at Laurelhurst Park!
events.detail: A playful class using props and storytelling to get toddlers moving. $18.

events.title: Santa Photos | An Elf™ Christmas Experience at Vancouver Mall
events.detail: Magical holiday photo experience with Santa. Price not listed.

events.title: Curiosity Kids: Sasquatch Science Team
events.detail: A science activity for kids from 9 am to 10 am.

events.title: Storytime at Washington County Libraries
events.detail: Daily storytimes for various age groups including toddlers. Free.

events.title: CHAP Art Club
events.detail: Art workshops designed for children with medical challenges. No price listed.

events.title: Spanish Story & Play Time with Adventures in Spanish
events.detail: A joyful hour of stories, songs, and play in Spanish.

events.title: Kennedy School’s 111th Birthday Bash
events.detail: Celebration featuring face painting and birthday fun. Free.

events.title: Holiday Open House at The Nature Store
events.detail: Annual holiday shopping kickoff event at the nature store.

events.title: OMSI On Ice
events.detail: Indoor synthetic ice skating for families. $8 – $10.

events.title: Mike Bennett's Dead Media Holiday Special
events.detail: VHS-themed holiday event with lights and photo ops. Free.

events.title: The Portland Princess Ball
events.detail: An enchanting ball where guests meet nine princesses. $45.

events.title: Santa at Clackamas Town Center
events.detail: Photo opportunities with Santa at Macy's Home Court for $20.

events.title: Creative Movement Dance Class for 2 Year Olds
events.detail: A dance class for two-year-olds to explore movement from 9am to 9:45am.

events.title: Open Play at Laurelhurst Studio!
events.detail: Drop-in playtime for families from 9am to 12pm for $10.

events.title: St. Johns Farmers Market
events.detail: A market featuring over 80 local vendors and artisan goods from 9am to 2pm.

events.title: Pittock Mansion: Home for the Holidays
events.detail: The mansion decorated for 'Holidays from Around the World'; Travel Portland lists Nov. 16, 2026 to Jan. 10, 2027, with days and times that vary.

events.title: ZooLights Sensory-Friendly
events.detail: Families with sensory processing needs can enjoy light displays from 4:30 to 8:30 p.m.

events.title: ZooLights
events.detail: Wildlife-themed holiday lights. A third-party guide reports Nov. 20, 2026 to Jan. 3, 2027, opening at 4:30 p.m., with tickets for specific dates; the zoo hasn't fully posted its 2026 calendar. Go early in the evening with little ones.

events.title: U-cut Christmas trees at Sauvie Island Farms
events.detail: The farm's blog says its U-cut tree field opens Nov. 21 to Dec. 24, 9 a.m. to 5 p.m., self-serve on the honor system; all trees $60, cash or Venmo.

events.title: Topaz Farm Holiday Market and Christmas trees
events.detail: Holiday market with Christmas trees, wreaths and garlands; a community event listing reports opening day Thursday, Nov. 26, 2026, 10 a.m. to noon. Season hours not yet confirmed by the farm.

events.title: Winter Wonderland drive-through lights
events.detail: Drive-through holiday light show benefiting Sunshine Division; a BringFido listing gives Nov. 27 to Dec. 31, 2026 with evening hours. Easy with a toddler since you stay in the car.

events.title: Curiosity Kids: Design and Discover
events.detail: A science activity for kids from 9 am to 10 am.

events.title: The Polar Express
events.detail: An event themed around The Polar Express.
